configure_logger: configure the root logger with a log file, log level, and stdout handler using tqdm
create_TqdmLoggingHandler: create a TqdmLoggingHandler that writes log messages via tqdm.tqdm.write to avoid corrupting progress bars
create_MultiLineFormatter: create a MultiLineFormatter that applies the log format prefix to each line of multi-line log messages
handle_uncaught_exception: handle uncaught exceptions by logging them as errors and shutting down the logging system
disable_logger_temporarily: disable the logger at a given level within a context manager and restore the previous level on exit
